signature.one_line: Music-only kinetic-type manifesto: one giant word per card flipping black/cream on the beat, accent punchline word, recurring 3D ball, logo hold.
unique_devices: One giant black-weight word per card, a new card every 6-12 frames, background flipping black <-> cream on every cut so each cut is a contrast flip
A recurring glossy accent 3D ball that interacts with the type (bounces, swings as a pendulum and knocks letters out, becomes a light source)
Word-over-montage: one condensed white word held dead-centre while ~10 full-screen 3D backgrounds swap under it
Rhythm shaped as burst / slow light-sweep / burst / long logo hold
signature.why_it_works: Every cut changes contrast on the beat, so it stops the scroll with no speaker; one moving object stitches the cards together and the long final hold lands the brand.

hook.first_frame: glossy accent 3D ball on black; the first lowercase word arrives centred at frame ~15 with a tracking collapse

structure.what: 8 one-word cards on the beat, black/cream flips, accent punchline word
2-line uppercase manifesto on cream; line 2 swaps question -> answer while a pendulum ball knocks letters
slow section: dark wipe, the ball glows into a light source, a light cone sweeps across second accent
brand word held centre over a rapid montage of 3D backgrounds
logo assembled from extruded tiles on electric second accent, long hold

pacing.notes: cut-rate curve 96 / 24 / 96 / 42 cuts/min per 5-second window: two bursts with a slow light-sweep between; 28 % soft cuts (dark wipe, light sweep); cuts land on the beat (~75 BPM grid, cut_hit_share 0.4)

background_text.how: top-left x 5 %, y ~13.5 %, ~1 % H, colour flips with the card

motion_graphics.how: Inter 900 ~236-324 px -0.03em centred at y 50 %; tracking collapse (2 frames) or scale 1.25 -> 1 + rise 15 % H (4 frames, power3.out, no overshoot); hard cut every 6-12 frames
3D ball on a string swings across the manifesto card; letters of the last line scatter with motion trails on impact
the ball glows and a cream light cone sweeps across a second accent field; slow (2 shots)
extruded cream/accent tiles assemble into the mark on electric second accent, then hold

cards_lists.how: Poppins 900 ~172 px -0.06em, lines at y 35.4 % / 44.8 %, line 2 in accent swaps question -> answer

broll_inserts.how: ~10 full-screen glossy renders (blob, primary-colour geometric blocks, spiral tunnel, halftone, falling shapes, extruded grid), 6-12 frames each

layout.how: no footage, no person; all text centred

camera.how: pendulum swing, light sweep, 3D render moves; no footage

transitions.what: hard cuts on the beat with contrast flip
transitions.how: black <-> cream background flip on each cut
~12-frame dark wipe into the slow section

end_card.how: longest shot in the piece (~105 frames) after the fastest burst

type.letterform_evidence: near-circular o and bowls, flat-topped narrow t, flat stroke ends, very heavy; the original is more geometric than Inter (Gilroy/Outfit-like) - Poppins/Montserrat Black are closer in shape but ~15 % wider; Inter 900 at -0.03em matches the height/width ratio
type.color: #09080A on cream cards; cream #EFE7D3 on black cards; the punchline word solid orange #FD5815 on cream
type.size_spread: not fit-to-width and not constant: a 7-letter punchline word solves to ~236 px (ink 9.2 % H, 60 % W); a 2-letter word ~45 % W

other_text_spec.when: hook 0-17 %: a new card every 6-12 frames (8 cards)
other_text_spec.script: latin, English on-screen copy; nothing is spoken
other_text_spec.case: lowercase with punctuation (full stops kept, curly apostrophe)
other_text_spec.layout: single word centred horizontally (x ~15-86 %), centre y 50 %; background flips black #0A090B <-> cream #F0E7D2 on (almost) every card
other_text_spec.animation: hard cut to the new card on the beat; the word arrives over 2-4 frames: either a tracking collapse (letters spread wide -> normal in 2 frames) or a scale-down + rise (~1.25x and ~15 % H low -> settled in 4 frames, ease-out, no overshoot)

type.font_class: geometric sans caps, black weight, very tight tracking
type.letterform_evidence: round C and O, vertical-sided M, letters nearly touching
type.color: line 1 #09080A, line 2 (the payoff) orange #FD5815, or both black
type.fit_note: an 8-character orange payoff line solved to 168 px; use 168-177 px

other_text_spec.when: 17-39 % (one long shot; line 2 swaps every ~15-24 frames)
other_text_spec.layout: two centred lines: line 1 centre y 35.4 % (~46 % W), line 2 centre y 44.8 % (~66 % W); line pitch 9.4 % H (leading ~1.0)
other_text_spec.animation: line 2 swaps while line 1 holds (question -> answer pattern: 'LEAD WORD?' / 'ANSWER.'); a swinging pendulum ball crosses and knocks letters out of the last line (letter scatter with motion trails)

type.shadow: hard dark drop shadow / dark edge so it reads over busy 3D renders (estimated 0 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6) at 1080)
type.calibration_note: a 6-letter lowercase brand word measured ink 13.52 % H, 72.2 % W; compute expected ink for the user's word with fit_font.py

other_text_spec.animation: text held perfectly still while full-screen 3D backgrounds hard-cut underneath every 6-12 frames

other_text_spec.text: tiny mono (JetBrains-Mono-like) @handle, dark on cream / light on black, top-left x 5 %, y ~13.5 %, ~1 % H
brand mark built from cream and orange extruded 3D tiles on electric blue (#162CB3-like); a 3D render, not live text

style.look_intent: pure graphic palette: high-contrast, natural-saturation, cool overall; black, warm cream, signal orange and electric blue with glossy soft-shadow 3D renders

sound.music: music only (bed likely, beat ~75 BPM est., periodicity 0.45); rhythmic track drives every cut
sfx: optional impact / scatter hit when the pendulum ball knocks letters
optional riser under the light-cone sweep into the montage

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Beat-Synced Editing
catalog_styles.role: card cuts on the music grid

use_when: a brand / product launch teaser or manifesto with no speaker
a title or chapter burst inside a longer video
the user has a music track with a clear beat and a short punchy copy line
the brand has a strong 2-3 colour palette and can use 3D or bold graphic assets
avoid_when: talking-head or interview footage that needs speech captions
long or explanatory copy (one word per card only)
no music or a beatless track
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B43 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B43.json) to this brand.
This blueprint has NO speech captions: the kinetic type is the content. Cover only the text cards and edit devices below.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: {{TEXT}} on {{SURFACE}} and {{SURFACE}}-coloured text on {{CARD_BG}} >= 7:1, {{ACCENT}} on {{SURFACE}} >= 3:1)
- {{TEXT}} word-card ink on light cards - default near-black #09080A
- {{ACCENT}} punchline word / payoff line / recurring 3D object - default signal orange #FD5815
- {{ACCENT_2}} logo-hold field - default electric blue #1A39EF (render #162CB3-like)
- {{SURFACE}} light card - default warm cream #F0E7D2
- {{CARD_BG}} dark card - default near-black #0A090B
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} word cards - default Inter 900 (geometric Black faces like Gilroy/Outfit are closer); manifesto - Poppins 900; held brand word - Anton 400
- {{FONT_BODY}} handle watermark - default JetBrains Mono
- {{HANDLE}} - @handle, tiny, top-left
- {{LOGO}} - the brand mark for the final hold (3D extruded tiles in {{SURFACE}} / {{ACCENT}} on {{ACCENT_2}})

Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps. Music-only; cut to the beat.

1. Hook burst (first ~17 % of runtime): 8 one-word cards, a new card every 6-12 frames on the beat, background flipping {{CARD_BG}} <-> {{SURFACE}} on every cut. Word lowercase with punctuation, centred at y 50 %, {{FONT_DISPLAY}} ~324 px for a 5-letter word (ink 12.5 % H, ~70 % W; not fit-to-width - a 7-letter word ~236 px), tracking -0.03em, {{TEXT}} on {{SURFACE}} / {{SURFACE}} on {{CARD_BG}}; ONE punchline word in solid {{ACCENT}}. Entry over 2-4 frames: tracking collapse (spread letters -> normal) or scale 1.25 -> 1 with a 15 % H rise, power3.out, no overshoot. No shadow, stroke or box.
2. Recurring object: one glossy {{ACCENT}} 3D object in every early shot that interacts with the type (bounce, pendulum swing, knocks letters out, becomes a light source).
3. Manifesto (next ~23 %): {{SURFACE}} card, two centred UPPERCASE lines, Poppins 900 ~172 px, -0.06em, line centres y 35.4 % / 44.8 % (pitch 9.4 % H); line 1 {{TEXT}} holds while line 2 ('ANSWER.') swaps in {{ACCENT}} every ~15-24 frames; the pendulum ball knocks letters of the last line out with motion trails.
4. Slow section (next ~27 %): ~12-frame dark wipe, then the object glows and a {{SURFACE}} light cone sweeps across navy; only 2 shots.
5. Word over montage (next ~16 %): the brand word in Anton ~296 px, white, centred (y 49.9 %, x 14-86 %), hard dark shadow (0 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.6)), held still while ~10 full-screen 3D backgrounds hard-cut underneath every 6-12 frames.
6. Logo hold (last ~18 %, ~105 frames): {{LOGO}} assembled from extruded {{SURFACE}}/{{ACCENT}} tiles on {{ACCENT_2}}.
7. {{HANDLE}} tiny mono, top-left x 5 %, y ~13.5 %, ~1 % H, colour flipping with the card, until the montage.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py) if any footage is used; target look: high-contrast, natural-saturation, cool graphic palette with glossy soft-shadow 3D.
SOUND: music only, mastered to about -14 LUFS with true peak <= -1 dBTP; cuts on beats; optional impact on letter knock-outs and a riser into the montage.

VERIFY before rendering (px values were render-verified with local fonts; if the brand font differs, adjust px until the numbers match):
a) Render test frames: "don’t" ({{FONT_DISPLAY}} 324 px, -0.03em, {{TEXT}} on {{SURFACE}}), "MADE" (Poppins 900 177 px, -0.06em), and "KEY WORD" as the held brand word (Anton 296 px, white over a dark area).
b) Measure: python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test render or snapshot> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.1,0.41,0.9,0.6 --ink "{{TEXT}}:80" (word card); --box 0.2,0.3,0.8,0.395 --ink "{{TEXT}}:80" (manifesto line 1); --box 0.08,0.41,0.92,0.59 --ink "#FEFDFD:60" (held word).
c) Required: "don’t" ink 12.66 % +-0.5 of H and 70.0 % +-2 of W; "MADE" 6.48 % +-0.5 and 45.7 % +-2. For the held brand word compute the expected ink with python video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "Anton 400" --word "<brand word>" at 296 px.
